findings.title: Comments still describe the removed grid button (styles.css:3125, 3141; icons.tsx:87)
findings.scoreReason: The reviewer is right: styles.css:3125 and 3141 and the IconChevronDown docstring still describe the removed grid button, but rewording three comments is a quick edit to do now on this branch, not a separate work item.

findings.title: aria-pressed on a menu button mixes toggle and menu-button semantics
findings.scoreReason: The claim holds, since the chevron carries both aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-pressed and is announced as a toggle, but the impact for screen-reader users is minor, the owner asked for aria-pressed in the Issue 70 refinement, and changing it means reopening the spec and D2, so it belongs in the final review comment rather than a work item.

findings.title: The chevron's 22/18 px width departs from the --tap touch-target rule without an exception in web-standards
findings.scoreReason: The narrow chevron width predates this PR and D2 records it as the owner's choice, so the only open action is a one-line exception in web-standards.md:35, which is too small to track as an item.
